instruction: You are given money paid out of a taxpayer's bank account, one debit per line, numbered. Say which kind each one is, using only the names listed below. Answer with a JSON object and nothing else, whose keys are the numbers as they appear and whose values are the names. Give a name only if the wording of the debit supports it. Where the wording does not say what the money was for, answer unclear.
name: money paid out

model.instruction: Say what this money paid out of a bank account was for.

kinds.medical_insurance: A premium for medical or health insurance, paid to an insurer.
kinds.pension: A contribution to a personal pension or retirement plan.
kinds.housing_loan: An instalment on a loan taken to buy or build a home.
kinds.school_fees: Fees paid to a school, college or university.
kinds.donation: A donation made electronically to a charity or a non profit organisation.
kinds.carer_wages: Wages paid to a carer who looks after someone at home.
kinds.green_equipment: A purchase of solar panels, a solar water heater, rainwater harvesting equipment or an electric vehicle charger.
kinds.business_expense: A cost of running a business, such as stock, supplies, premises, staff or services bought for the business.
kinds.bills: A bill for electricity, water, phone, internet or television.
kinds.bank_charges: A fee or charge the bank takes, such as an account fee, a transfer fee, a card fee or a commission.
kinds.tax_paid: A payment of income tax to the tax authority, such as a quarterly payment or the balance due on a return.
kinds.unclear: A payment whose payee or purpose the statement does not show, such as a transfer to a person or a wallet with no stated purpose.
kinds.no_claim: Everyday spending, cash withdrawals, card repayments, taxes other than income tax, and transfers between the holder's own accounts.

pension.asking: select yes if all these payments went into your personal pension scheme. The scheme must have the approval that the insurance law specified. Get a document that shows this approval from the scheme

donation.asking: select yes if you paid all these donations electronically to a charity with approval from the tax authority

carer_wages.asking: select yes if you paid the social contributions for each carer

medical_insurance.asking: the certificate from the insurer shows the premium for each insured person. Type one amount for each person. Type your amount first

school_fees.asking: the receipt from the school shows the fees for each child. Type one amount for each child

housing_loan.asking: the certificate from the lender shows the interest that you paid in the year. Type this amount as housing loan interest

green_equipment.asking: add the invoice. The invoice shows the type of equipment: solar, rainwater harvesting or a fast charger

business_expense.asking: select the payments for your business, or type the business part of the total

bank_charges.asking: select the charges on your business account, or type the business part of the total

bills.asking: select the bills for your business, or type the business part of the total

tax_paid.asking: select the income tax payments for this income year. Tax for a previous year does not count

headlines.bills: which bills are for your business?
headlines.bank_charges: which bank charges are for your business?
headlines.pension: did these payments go into your approved pension scheme?
headlines.donation: did these donations go to an approved charity?
headlines.carer_wages: did you pay the social contributions for each carer?
headlines.green_equipment: add the invoice for the equipment
headlines.tax_paid: which payments are income tax for this year?

earlier.tax_paid: income tax that you pay from July to October is for the previous year. The last date for the return of that year is 15 October
